notes: The colophon says only 'saṃvat 806'. NS comes from the catalogue field and gives 1686 CE, which fits a Devanagari paper manuscript. Place: the text reads śrīmad-bhogaleśvaramaṭha-, but the catalogue gives Galeśvaramaṭha. That reading is possible if the text is a misprint for śrīmad-galeśvara (cf. Galeśvara/Galeshwor in western Nepal), so the identification is uncertain. The month '(parālagna)' is corrupt or doubtful, possibly Phālguna. The cataloguer flagged the weekday 'bhauma' with (!). 'paṇḍitācārya' may be one compound title. The last part of the work title in the first line ('mohādhūrottaraṃ sa....') is unclear.
